title: Kalshi US visits soar 1,500% as regulatory pressure mounts
summary: Kalshi’s US web traffic climbed more than 1,500% in less than a year, while trading volume grew even faster and legal scrutiny of its sports contracts intensified.

title: Trezor says data breach affects another 67K US customers
summary: Trezor said an additional 67,000 US users were affected by its shipping provider’s data breach, opening the path to potential phishing attacks and social engineering scams.

title: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap
summary: South Korea’s financial regulator introduced a three-phase roadmap for the issuance of tokenized assets, as the country prepares to adopt its first tokenized securities framework in February 2027.

title: AMC chief criticizes Robinhood’s tokenized stock plan
summary: AMC’s CEO criticized Robinhood’s tokenized stock offerings for being unregulated in the US and said he will request an investigation from an external securities counsel.

title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $731M, highest since January as BTC reclaims $80K
summary: US Bitcoin ETFs drew $730.9 million on Thursday as Bitcoin reclaimed $80,000, though CryptoQuant flagged weak fresh demand and a key $83,000 test.

title: El Salvador’s post-review Bitcoin accumulation used no public funds: IMF
summary: The IMF attributed Bitcoin added since June 2025 to private donations, addressing questions raised after El Salvador reported a $100 million acquisition.

title: US, UK launch joint alliance targeting crypto scam centers
summary: The agreement includes parallel investigations and information sharing, with US and UK authorities planning a private-sector disruption operation in London in October.
